espresso-ink.$description: Espresso Ink — Primary text, headings, nav links, body copy, and outlined button borders — a warm dark brown that replaces pure black and gives the whole system a softer, editorial voice

fog-border.$description: Fog Border — Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and icon strokes across cards, nav, and body containers

cream-canvas.$description: Cream Canvas — Page background and card surfaces — the off-white that everything sits on, warmer than pure white

lime-spark.$description: Lime Spark — Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

lilac-whisper.$description: Lilac Whisper — Decorative pastel surface used inside product mockups and gradient washes — soft lavender that recedes behind content

mint-tint.$description: Mint Tint — Decorative pastel surface — light green used in card backgrounds and gradient endpoints

lemon-cream.$description: Lemon Cream — Decorative pastel surface — pale lemon used in testimonial card washes and gradient stops

sky-hush.$description: Sky Hush — Decorative pastel surface — muted blue used as occasional card background accent

favorit.$description: Body text, links, nav items, card content — same family as ABC Favorit with slightly looser line-height (1.5) for reading comfort

tobias.$description: Display serif for hero and section headlines — large sizes with tight tracking (-0.02em) create editorial gravitas. The light weight (300) is anti-convention for hero text; most sites use 600-700, this whisper-weight signals confidence and restraint

abc-favorit.$description: Primary UI and body typeface — neo-grotesque with slight warmth, weight 350 for body and 400 for emphasis. Tight tracking (-0.02em) at larger sizes gives headings a compressed, modern feel

favorit-bold.$description: Emphasis headings and subheads — bold weight with aggressive tracking (-0.037em) creates a tight, assertive counterpoint to the light serif displays

favorit-regular.$description: Favorit-Regular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
